subject: ci: Add cpplint workflow to run linter on PRs (#100)
reason: The change is purely CI tooling: it adds a .github/workflows/linter.yml workflow that runs cpplint on PRs and widens the lint filter lists in src/json/CPPLINT.cfg and tst/unit/CPPLINT.cfg. No C++ source, build script, or module behavior changes, so the compiled valkey-json module is byte-for-byte functionally identical to its parent and no runtime path can reach the change.
